_doc: BEH enforcement registry (§3.6, §6.5). Authoritative catalog of every Behavior Enforcement Harness point. Schema validated + cross-checked against .claude/settings.json by beh-registry.js (registration-drift guard). Plan: .agents/progress/behavior-enforcement-harness-plan-2026-06-11.md

entries.name: drift-ledger
entries.check: append-only ledger entry; match against the running scope item's pre-declared milestones; record verify-command receipts (§3.2)

entries.name: drift-tick
entries.check: evaluateDrift over ledger + bound progress: active_stall / starvation / phase_ceiling / new_value_zero / scope_undeclared
entries.action: inject drift notice + persist inject barrier
entries.escalation: same invariant ignored K turns after inject → hard-stop (surfaced by drift-tick, enforced by termination-gate)
entries.recovery: advance a milestone / re-evaluate approach / user disposition

entries.name: termination-gate
entries.check: all scope items disposed (done/deferred/abandoned)? every done item has a valid, non-stale completion receipt (§3.2)? latched hard-stop?
entries.fail_mode: fail-safe exit 0 (allow stop) on any error — never trap on a bug
entries.recovery: dispose items + valid receipts | rm .claude/beh-on | touch .claude/beh-reset (user-auth)

entries.name: tool-less-watchdog
entries.check: evaluateDrift with real clock — catches a running item gone silent past its wall stall window with no new turn
entries.action: write .claude/beh-stuck flag (surfaced next turn) + exit 3 on --once
entries.fail_mode: best-effort; platform limit = mid-turn injection not guaranteed (Stop-time + flag only)

entries.name: supervise
entries.trigger: explicit long/background tool process wrapped by the agent
entries.check: evaluateSupervisor: wall + stall (grace, monotonic, rate-sanity) + degraded + lease + probe-type allowlist
entries.action: kill via systemd cgroup (confirm populated=0) or PGID (degraded), targeted
entries.fail_mode: free-form probe → fail-closed kill; unconfirmed kill → hard-failure report

entries.name: pretool-gate
entries.check: session-start handshake valid (settings.json hash-bound, fresh)? unsupervised background (&/nohup/setsid/run_in_background) not via supervise?
entries.action: block (decision:block) on fail-closed handshake or unsupervised background
entries.fail_mode: fail-safe exit 0 (allow) on any error; launcher + supervise wrapper always allowed
entries.escalation: blocks every tool until handshake re-established

entries.name: session-start-notice
entries.action: inject advisory warning (cannot block — pretool-gate enforces)

entries.name: launcher
entries.check: required hooks registered in settings.json + cores load (require self-probe)
entries.action: write settings-hash-bound handshake; FAIL (no handshake) if verification fails
entries.fail_mode: exit 1 + no handshake → pretool-gate keeps blocking (fail-closed root)
entries.recovery: register the missing hook / fix the core, then re-run

entries.name: second-stream
entries.check: probabilistic 2nd-LLM reads ONLY structured ledger events
entries.fail_mode: death/absence has no effect on deterministic enforcement
